name: XDJRX-MOD 1.0
title: stock rbp 2.21 + libxdjmod (EVENT 3c)
aplNew:
# XDJMOD: library (Utility entries, cue modes, meter, mono, health log in xdjmod-capture on a stick)
		# safe start: the previous start didn't run 60 s healthy (hung, or switched off early) -> no library this time
		if [ -e /root/rbp/xdjmod-starting ]; then
			rm -f /root/rbp/xdjmod-starting
			sync
			echo "safe start: no library" > /dev/shm/xdjmod-mode
			( /root/pioneer/rbp > /dev/shm/rbp_console.txt 2>&1; echo "rbp ended: $? at $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)" >> /dev/shm/rbp_exit.txt ) &
		else
			echo 1 > /root/rbp/xdjmod-starting
			sync
			echo "library" > /dev/shm/xdjmod-mode
			( LD_PRELOAD=/root/pioneer/libxdjmod.so XDJMOD_SWITCH=/root/rbp/xdjmod-hpmode XDJMOD_STARTING=/root/rbp/xdjmod-starting XDJMOD_OUT=scan:xdjmod-capture XDJMOD_STATE=/tmp/xdjmod-state /root/pioneer/rbp > /dev/shm/rbp_console.txt 2>&1; echo "rbp ended: $? at $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)" >> /dev/shm/rbp_exit.txt ) &
		fi
